Heat pump warranties

Most major manufacturers cover the compressor for 10 years and other parts for 5 years, provided the unit is registered within 90 days of installation. Labour is typically covered for the first year only.

Registration is the step most often missed. An unregistered unit usually falls back to a 5 year compressor term.

What warranties do not cover

Damage from incorrect installation, and any unit serviced by an unapproved contractor, is excluded. Manufacturers do not publish field failure statistics in their warranty documents.
